about: German's lens's held-out lines (docs/plans/05-built/case-de.md): every 79th line of the Kärnten village's scenes, stories and readings with a noun inside it, a word of it labelled by hand (machine-written, Claude, 2026-11-03) before the lens ran on them: its case and number. The smoke runs German's lens over them (test/smoke/case-de.ts): never a wrong case said as sure.
